note: This is data, not decoration. `architecture` is what tells the loader which
engine a model belongs to, and nothing in a model's own files states it
reliably. Adding a model means adding a row here, not a branch in the loader.
`accuracy` and `speed` are 0-100 and deliberately coarse. They exist to let
someone choose without knowing what a mel spectrogram is, and they are
relative to the other rows in this file, not to any benchmark.
HOSTING: every URL points at the model's canonical upstream on Hugging Face,
pinned to a commit, with the file's own sha256 recorded. The whisper files are
ggerganov's reference ggml builds - the same bytes bard used to fetch from a
third-party mirror, verified identical by size and hash before the switch.
Non-whisper families need a GGUF conversion upstream does not publish; those
will be converted and hosted under bard's own org rather than taken from
